## Frequently Asked Questions

Will the protected Territory provide enough freedom for me to do business?

The Most Market Potential Franchise. Our standard protected territory has a population of up to 200,000, allowing us the freedom to advertise and accept clients throughout the Metro area without the need to purchase additional franchises. Your territory is optimally protected from other franchises within our system.

How do I select my territory?

We will assist in the selection process by proposing a specific area that has been vetted for viability. We also work with you to determine the best territory possible for your success.

Do all states require licenses?

Many states require [Private Duty](https://www.livingassistance.com/private-duty-homecare) home care agencies to be licensed, and the number is growing (similar legislation is pending in several states). If there is no license requirement in your state at present, just wait; it will likely be introduced soon. We provide computerized policy and procedure files that can be used for licensing applications in many states.

Are your in-home care franchises licensed in the states that require licensing?

Yes. Having the required license not only provides credibility for your agency but also opens doors to referrals. Doors tend to be closed to agencies that are perceived as circumventing state law.
